tagline: The quiet buyer who just took the 1.01.
file: A win-now buyer who pays with the future. Stays out of the chat and lets the transaction log do the talking.
Quietly converting picks into veterans. Deebo Samuel cost a 2027 2nd, Jake Ferguson cost Colston Loveland, and Matthew Stafford cost two future 2nds and $100 of FAAB.
The scoring column. 649.78 points is the lowest total in the league.
Whether the 1.01 turns into a seller's market, and whether Stafford ever scores again like Week 5.

2026.headline: 3-3, the 1.01, and the lowest points total in the league
story: Snipe58 does not post much, but the ledger is loud. He bought Deebo Samuel for a 2027 2nd, traded Loveland for Ferguson, and paid a 2028 2nd, a 2029 2nd and $100 of FAAB for Stafford. Each deal was a present-tense purchase funded with future capital.

Week 6 was an 89.08 to 83.34 loss to Hades9mm, the lowest-scoring game of the week, with Germie Bernard leading at 25.7 and 12.1 left on the bench. The record is 3-3, down three spots to 9th. His 638.52 points against are the fewest in the league, so the schedule has been kind.

The 751.78 MAXPF is the lowest in the league, and it makes him the 1.01 holder, 53.9 points ahead of Darkspaces. The poll gave him two votes, and the desk called seven points behind and closing. Justin Jefferson, Brock Purdy and Stafford are the roster's core. FAAB is $400.
takes: Buys the present, sells the future, and ended up with the first pick.
The lowest score in the league and the best seat in the draft.
